description: The provider the backend pushes in a guardrail check's config.provider, by check name (_RULE_PROVIDER_DEFAULTS, futureagi/agentcc/services/config_push.py). The gateway's dynamic guardrail factory (dynamicFactory, agentcc-gateway/cmd/agentcc/main.go) builds a check as the guardrail whose recogniser accepts that provider, and builds nothing for a provider none accepts, so the gateway then skips the check without an error. The backend's test (futureagi/agentcc/tests/test_gateway_admin_contracts.py) pins its mapping to this file, and the gateway's test (agentcc-gateway/cmd/agentcc/guardrail_providers_test.go) checks that dynamicFactory builds each check here, from its provider, as the check's own guardrail, so renaming a provider in the backend mapping or in a gateway recogniser fails a test.
